description.value: Caffè Soccavo is an Italian-style neighbourhood café on Vancouver's vibrant Commercial Drive, serving espresso, wood-fired paninos, and Neapolitan-style pizzas in a casual, soccer-watching atmosphere. The café leans into its 'Little Italy' identity with charcuterie, antipasto, and an aperitivo-hour tradition, making it a social stop rather than a grab-and-go. For touring cyclists on the Commercial Drive corridor, it offers a full sit-down meal or a quick takeout option.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 43m; stands (3 spaces) at 66m; stands (2 spaces) at 97m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is an active Italian café at 1321 Commercial Dr, Vancouver, matching OSM address and phone number exactly. Takeout is confirmed by the prominent 'Order For Pick Up' and 'Order Delivery' options on the website; vegetarian and vegan options are evident from the menu (veggie pizza, caprese, vegan mozz substitution). No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM opening_hours tag does not match the extended hours shown on the current website — OSM tag may be outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, full-service Italian café on the cycling-friendly Commercial Drive corridor with confirmed takeout and vegetarian options; a useful mid-ride stop for touring cyclists in East Vancouver.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Multiple vegetarian options on menu (Caprese Salad, House Salad, Vinny Verdi veggie sub, Veggie pizza, Margherita pizza); vegan mozzarella substitution explicitly listed ('SUB VEGAN MOZZ'). No GF mention found
